lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, displaying discrete local maxima against a dark grey background.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with shadow accumulation on the ventral side of the ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple remoras (Echeneidae) is visible swimming in close proximity to the pectoral fin and ventral-lateral gill region.
